user.title: Choose Govee model and full-control transport
user.description: Only transports verified for individual elements are used. Matter can provide basic device control but not individual panels or LEDs in this integration.

menu_options.h6069: H6069 Mini Panel Lights — full control: LAN; Matter: basic only
menu_options.h70b3: H70B3 Curtain Lights 2 — full control: Bluetooth/proxy; LAN and Matter: basic only

h6069.title: Add H6069 via local LAN
h6069.description: Full panel control is physically verified through UDP LAN. Enable LAN Control in Govee Home. Setup sends no pattern.

h70b3.title: Add H70B3 via Bluetooth
h70b3.description: Full 520-LED control requires a local Bluetooth adapter or an active ESPHome Bluetooth proxy. Setup sends no image.
